reflection.scripture: Jesus replied: “ ‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.’
reflection.observation: Jesus is asked what the greatest commandment is, and He doesn't hesitate — it's love for God, completely and totally. Not partial, not occasional, but with every part of who we are: heart (our emotions and desires), soul (our deepest self), and mind (our thoughts and intellect). This isn't about checking religious boxes; it's about an all-encompassing devotion that touches every corner of our lives.
reflection.application: Today, I can examine where I'm holding back. Is there an area of my life — my schedule, my relationships, my worries — where I'm not inviting God in fully? Loving God with all my mind might mean starting my day with scripture instead of scrolling. With all my heart might mean worship even when I don't feel like it. With all my soul might mean surrendering the outcomes I've been gripping too tightly.
reflection.prayer: Lord, You deserve my whole heart, not the leftovers. Show me where I've been divided in my devotion. Help me love You with every part of who I am — my thoughts, my passions, my plans, my fears. Let today be a step toward wholeness in You. In Jesus' name, Amen.
